description_en: Set to `1` to allow the proxy to perform DNS resolution instead of the caller. Opt-in for environments where the proxy should handle hostname resolution
description_ja: 1に設定すると、呼び出し元ではなくプロキシ側でDNSホスト名の解決を行うようになります。

related_changelog.content: - Fixed proxy DNS resolution being forced on by default. Now opt-in via `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS=true` environment variable
